Patch Set 16:

(19 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Problematic, see inline comments. The patch is carrying a large amount of debug instrumentation: CDEBUG() calls converted to CERROR() and new CERROR() debug prints in ll_intent_release(), ll_intent_lock(), ll_create_it(), ll_prep_md_op_data(), lmv_locate_tgt(), mdc_create_pack(), mdc_open_pack() and mdt_finish_open()/mdt_reint_open(). Those sites are on the open/create fast path for every file on both client and MDT, so this floods the console and the debug log for workloads that never touch O_TMPFILE, not just for tmpfile users. Please strip all of it before the next refresh.

The new test coverage is thin: tmpfile_test.c only checks that open(O_TMPFILE) returns a descriptor. Since the point of the feature is a nameless, open-unlinked file, consider also verifying st_nlink == 0, that data can be written and read back, and that linkat(fd, "", dirfd, path, AT_EMPTY_PATH) materialises the file.
